hypotheses.scope: physical cold and all resident desktops
hypotheses.confidence: Direct source call site; saving unmeasured
evidence: src/main.cpp:88 calls VisualStyle::apply before tray/adapter creation
src/ui/VisualStyle.cpp:72-145 applies full settings/history QSS to resident; helper independently applies it
Cold libpcre2-16 RSS 495616 bytes and Widgets RSS 3432448 bytes are attribution clues, not removable-byte estimates
hypotheses.probe: In isolated normal CMake build, separate only resident theme application into identical palette plus existing QMenu/QToolTip style, leaving full helper style unchanged. Compare application-construction, style-application, icon/tray and idle stages with unchanged distro Qt/theme/env. Run alternating baseline/candidate cold 300-second family measurements and native tray/capture/modal tests. First record staged counters without changing behavior to establish whether full QSS is material.
acceptance: Tray has same readable custom menu/colors/icons, all four actions and four view launchers
No unbounded timers or cache purging; keep only replicated whole-family saving

hypotheses.confidence: Large observed LLVM/Gallium/Quick/Qml/theme footprint; trigger unknown

KDE has QtQuick/Qml/QuickTemplates2 and KDEPlasmaPlatformTheme6 mappings despite app being Widgets
src/platform/kde/KdeRegionOverlay.cpp creates translucent QWidget layer surfaces only on capture; no QQuick/OpenGL request in this source
hypotheses.probe: Fresh isolated KDE test profile/current exact package; visible console awake and VNC intact. Record basename mappings and family RSS/PSS/private after resident readiness before actions, after tray menu, helper Settings close, native chooser close, desktop/window captures, cancelled selector and accepted selector, each followed by two-second cleanup and fixed 30-second quiet. Retain operation IDs, helper generations, native ownership, Qt/plugin/Mesa version and VM graphics identity. Attribute first appearance and subsequent resident growth. Do not assume QtQuick or LLVM were explicitly instantiated by app.
acceptance: Do not disable native platform theme/font/dialog integration to manufacture low RSS
No global Qt/Wayland/Mesa environment override in shipped app without proven feature parity
Report driver file-backed shared RSS separately but preserve user-facing total RSS

hypotheses.scope: each desktop post-use compared against its own fresh current-build baseline
hypotheses.confidence: Private anonymous post-use footprint observed; payload leak not established
evidence: VM anonymous: Cinnamon14602240, GNOME9334784, KDE11976704 bytes
Physical cold anonymous1114112 bytes is a different machine/workload, not a causal baseline

X11/KDE selector destructors delete surfaces; KDE image worker callbacks release completed objects
VM UI checkpoints only 2485-2522 serialized bytes, not near 8 MiB limit
hypotheses.probe: On each exact current guest build, instrument synthetic small/big image operations and cancelled/accepted region in separate fresh profiles. Fixed stages: before capture, acquired, encoded-to-disk, terminal copy, idle cleanup, external clipboard ownership replacement. Record aggregate live payload lease bytes, worker count, selector/surface count, UI checkpoint bytes, allocator arena/free/allocated totals and per-VMA anonymous RSS with identity hashes; no addresses/paths/payload data in durable export. Separate live clipboard bytes from dead allocations. Repeat N identical cycles to distinguish plateau from monotonic growth; same final synthetic clipboard content for comparisons. Do not clear user manual payload.
acceptance: Clipboard must still paste after helper exit
Terminal operation state, hashes/sizes, retries and cancellation unchanged
Free allocator pages only after existing idle guards; no freeing live clipboard MIME

repeatProtocol.perDesktop: Compare fresh current exact package against its own identical-display baseline; separate processes/profiles for control, cancelled selector and accepted capture variants.
repeatProtocol.syntheticPayload: Fixed resolution and deterministic image content; same final synthetic clipboard state across variants. Never manipulate user manual payload.
repeatProtocol.records: Each cycle before invocation, after acquisition, after immutable disk artifact encode, after terminal clipboard acknowledgement, after helper/selector worker exit and idle reclamation; record raw identity-guarded total family RSS/PSS/private and aggregate payload/frame/image/selector/worker/cache/clipboard-byte ownership counts.
repeatProtocol.outcome: Report per-cycle settled sequence, earliest plateau and final-minus-first within that desktop. If rising, attribute live object counts versus allocator free/retained totals before changing ownership. No monotonic growth claim from one post-use snapshot.
repeatProtocol.controls: Run a no-capture operation/diagnostic control with same observation/cleanup timing; record pixel formats/DPR/screen size, Qt/plugin/Mesa versions, operation IDs, terminal states, helper generation and clipboard revision. Do not change live-background transparency or tray/native dialogs.

hypotheses.scope: history latency/populated journal post-use; not leading cold 40 MiB hypothesis
hypotheses.confidence: Connections already close per worker; persistent page cache claim unsupported
evidence: src/app/HistoryService.cpp constructs local HistoryStore per background query
src/core/HistoryStore.cpp:33 closes database/removes connection in destructor
Bounded 200-row pages and QSqlQuery prepare bindings already present
OperationService creates a new QThread per background call; no persistent worker pool
hypotheses.probe: Use synthetic bounded journal sizes and fixed search/filter/page request sequence; record per-request wall time, worker create/finish, SQLite connection lifetime, prepare/exec counts and query plan, plus before/after family memory. Evaluate bounded statement reuse only if time attribution shows prepare/open costs dominate; evaluate a persistent thread-owned connection only together with idle connection disposal/retention measurement. Never share QSqlDatabase across threads or disable safe transactions.
acceptance: Deletion/publication acknowledgement/transaction rollback tests stay intact
Bounded history data, no bulk preload
Connection reuse may increase idle memory; compare latency and retained footprint together

nonStarters.proposal: Switch to cstdint / use smaller variables throughout
nonStarters.reason: Type spelling changes no size. Narrowing tiny bounded resident structs lacks measured multiplicity and risks overflow/ABI/alignment. Only investigate a named hot allocation with object-size and count evidence; no blanket packing.

nonStarters.proposal: More blind malloc_trim or free Qt caches periodically
nonStarters.reason: Startup and post-work gated malloc_trim already exist. Cold heap+anonymous is ~3.98 MiB live+free combined; this is not evidence any specific amount can be reclaimed. Trimming every idle tick risks latency/CPU with no attribution.

nonStarters.proposal: Treat libLLVM 48.28 MiB RSS as 48.28 MiB heap leak or removable saving
nonStarters.reason: Separate footprint reports only 5.98 MiB PSS and 2.14 MiB private for that mapping. Presence does not identify trigger/lifetime, and mapped code cannot safely be manually unloaded while plugin users remain.

nonStarters.proposal: Disable GTK/KDE theme or app fonts/dialogs
nonStarters.reason: User specifically requires Cinnamon-native fonts/dialogs. Platform integration regression would invalidate the target. Helper-native UI must be retained.

nonStarters.proposal: Replace QApplication with QGuiApplication or unload QtWidgets as a small patch
nonStarters.reason: Persistent QSystemTrayIcon/QMenu and X11/KDE QWidget capture overlays require Widgets today; compiled dependency remains. Native tray plus alternate surfaces is a separate major integration project with new acceptance burden, not known 3.27 MiB saving.

nonStarters.proposal: Clear clipboard to shrink post-use numbers
nonStarters.reason: Resident ownership is required for paste after helper exit. Only synthetic external clipboard replacement is a labeled diagnostic workload, not product behavior.

nonStarters.proposal: Global software/raster/Wayland EGL overrides based on KDE mappings
nonStarters.reason: No trigger evidence yet; could break translucent layer overlays, rendering or native theme. Cost locating comes first; any bounded diagnostic override must never be confused with production acceptance.
